title: Orchestra Basics 2026-11-04
coverage: Representative instrument prototypes. Violin-section spiccato, flute staccato and upright piano additionally include all available author dynamics/repetitions at three selected root notes. This is not a complete orchestral sample library.
limitations: Root MIDI pitch comes from the author SFZ map; source file octave labels vary.
Most instruments only have a few representative root pitches, not full-range coverage.
No automatic key mapping, round-robin player, sustain loop, or SFZ importer was added to SoundForge.
Working WAV copies are resampled/quantized only: no separate dynamic-layer normalization, source gain compensation remains metadata.
Natural vibrato and room sound may be present; subjective audition pending.
